Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Pierre Cardin ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Alain Meilland (1940-....) (France, before 2008).
Introduced in France by Meilland International (after 1997) in 2008 as 'Pierre Cardin'.
rows.Bloom: Deep pink, purple flecks. Strong fragrance. Average diameter 5". Very large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, classic hybrid tea, high-centered bloom form.
